hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Count binary arrays using zero zeroes and one ones such that no identical element appears consecutively more than limit times.

hints.title: State Definition
hints.text: Let dp0[i][j] represent valid arrays using i zeroes and j ones ending in zero, and dp1[i][j] represent valid arrays ending in one.

hints.title: Transition Equations
hints.text: Transition from preceding states by adding one element, subtracting paths that exceed the consecutive identical element limit.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: State transitions computed in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use dynamic programming with prefix subtraction to handle run-length limits in constant transition time.
